title: The kb-observer role lists commands its kbask session may not run, and one form that exits 2
goal: each command line .claude/agents/kb-observer.md names, the git log, git show and git status forms included, is admitted by kbask.ALLOWED_TOOLS (the role names the exact forms, not the bare git commands), and the coord wait form it gives runs (wait needs --since)

run:
import sys, re, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import kbask
def admits(rule, cmd):
    if not (rule.startswith("Bash(") and rule.endswith(")")):
        return False
    r = rule[5:-1]
    for suf in (":*", " *", "*"):
        if r.endswith(suf):
            r = r[:-len(suf)]
            return cmd == r or cmd.startswith(r + " ")
    return cmd == r
t = open(".claude/agents/kb-observer.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
cmds = [s for s in re.findall(r"`([^`]+)`", t) if s.startswith(("git ", "python3 _tools/"))]
miss = [c for c in cmds if not any(admits(r, c) for r in kbask.ALLOWED_TOOLS)]
waits = [c for c in cmds if c.startswith("python3 _tools/coord.py wait")]
bad = [c for c in waits if subprocess.run(c.split(), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60).returncode == 2]
print("named, not admitted:", miss, "wait form exits 2:", bad)
sys.exit(1 if miss or bad else 0)
